text: You're 18, and the money is yours now. What kind of person are you with money?

right.label: You only live once
right.result: You will live once, and in overdraft.

text: Your first election. The polling station is a school hall that smells of floor polish.

right.label: Go and vote
right.result: You get a sticker. You keep the sticker.

text: Everything you own has turned pink.
You're renting now. A parent calls to ask if you're eating vegetables.

right.label: Lie warmly
right.result: A potato is a vegetable.

text: Your flatmate's dishes have been in the sink for nine days. Something is growing.

right.label: Leave a note
right.result: The reply note is longer than yours.

text: The landlord wants to keep your deposit for a mark that was already there.
There's mould behind the wardrobe, and you've been breathing it for a while.

right.label: Fight the landlord
right.result: He sends a man with a tin of paint.

text: You're still in your childhood bedroom. The glow stars still glow.

right.label: Start looking at flats
right.result: You see the prices. You look at the stars.

text: The interviewer asks where you see yourself in five years.

right.label: Tell the truth
right.result: "Asleep." They laugh. You weren't joking.

text: The application wants experience you don't have. It's only one little line.

risk.result: They ask you about it. In detail.

text: A stranger online can double your money. There are testimonials and a very nice logo.

risk.result: The nice logo is gone. So is the $500.

text: A shop assistant offers you a store card. Ten percent off today!

right.label: Ten percent!
right.result: You saved $120 by spending $1,200.

text: The old car dies at a junction. Everyone behind you has an opinion.

risk.result: It dies again on the way home.

text: You've had a few, and your car is right there. It's only ten minutes.

risk.result: Blue lights in the mirror. A fine and a very long night.

text: Someone in the club toilets offers you a small bag. "You'll love it."

right.label: Take it

risk.result: You spend the next day in the ER with a very bored nurse.

right.result: Two good hours. Then a very bad Tuesday.

text: Your head is a bass drum, and work starts in forty minutes.

right.label: Go in anyway
right.result: You nod through a meeting. You agreed to something.

text: A gym offers you a year's membership. You feel a new you coming on.

risk.result: You go twice. It bills you twelve times.

text: You've eaten instant noodles for eleven days in a row.

right.label: Learn to cook one thing
right.result: It's a chilli. It's always going to be a chilli.

text: You've got a mole that looks different from how you remember it.

risk.result: You should have gone. It comes off, later than it should.

right.label: See a doctor
right.result: It's nothing. You're allowed to breathe.

text: You've been tired for months. You cried at a bus timetable.

right.label: Talk to someone
right.result: Saying it out loud helps more than you'd planned for.

text: The group chat from school has gone quiet. It's been four months.

right.label: Organise a night out
right.result: Everyone has the same jokes and new jobs.

text: A friend asks to borrow $1,000. They swear it's only until Friday.
Someone your age is getting married. Already. The gift list starts at $150.
Your friends are going travelling for a year. There's a spare bunk.

right.label: Go
right.result: You come back with a bracelet and opinions about rice.

text: It's 1am, and the tattoo place is open. Your friend knows a guy.

risk.result: It's spelled wrong. It's your own name.

text: You could sell stuff online at weekends. Everyone says it's easy.
A brown envelope from the tax office. Nothing good has ever come in brown.

right.label: Open it
right.result: You're owed $14.

text: Someone from your school just bought a house. You just bought a slightly nicer sponge.

right.label: Keep scrolling
right.result: It's 3am. You know the layout of their kitchen.

text: The food bank down the road is short of hands on Saturdays.
Your grandparent wants help with their phone. Again. It's the same button.

right.label: Go round
right.result: Twenty seconds on the phone. Three hours of stories and cake.

text: A pigeon has walked into your flat, and it seems to think it's paying rent.

right.label: Name it Gerald
right.result: Gerald brings friends.

text: A form asks for your "next of kin". You have to look up what that means.

right.label: Write your best friend
right.result: You text them. They're delighted and slightly scared.
